name: Round-leaved Sundew
detail: Drosera rotundifolia, common sundew or round-leaved sundew, is a carnivorous plant that grows in fens, marshes, and swamps.

name: Royal Bluebell
detail: Wahlenbergia gloriosa is a perennial herb from the Family Campanulaceae.

name: Rue
detail: Rue (Ruta graveolens), also known as herb-of-grace, is a type of Ruta cultivated as an herbaceous and ornamental plant.

name: Safari Sunset
detail: The Leucadendron ‘Safari Sunset’ is a favorite of gardeners and florists is an evergreen multi-stemmed shrub with vivid, deep red bracts forming exceptionally long stalks (over 1m or 3 feet) at the tips.

name: Saffron
detail: The saffron flower is single and terminal, purple, and comprises 6 petals, 3 stamens, and a style that ends with 3 orange-red stigmas.

name: Sage
detail: From culinary to medicinal uses, sage has long been an herb garden staple.

name: Salix
detail: The Salix genus’s trees, shrubs, and willows in the Salicaceae family are mainly native to northern temperate zones.

name: Salt Tree
detail: The Salt tree is a drought-tolerant shrub of the Order Sapindales.

name: Saltwort
detail: Saltwort is an annual herb from the Amaranth family.

name: Sanvitalia
detail: Sanvitalia procumbens is a cheery Mexican annual with blossoms like miniature zinnias.

name: Sasanqua
detail: Camellia sasanqua is a shrub that can grow to 60 cm-3.6 m.

name: Scabiosis
detail: Native to Africa, Asia, Europe, and the Caucasus, Scabiosa includes around 70 species of small annual and perennial herbaceous plants that belong to the Caprifoliaceae (honeysuckle) family.

name: Scille
detail: The Scilla genus includes around 80 species of bulbous herbaceous perennial plants in the Asparagaceae family, a subfamily of the Scilloideae.

name: Sea Thrift
detail: Armeria maritima, the sea thrift, sea pink, or common thrift, is a plant species in the family Plumbaginaceae.

name: Sedum
detail: In botanical gardens or gardening stores, you may have found plants named “Sedum” that are so different that you wonder if they are related to one another.

name: Senecio
detail: Senecio is a genus of Asteraceae (sunflower) plants, including groundsels and ragwort.

name: Shasta Daisy
detail: The cheery Shasta daisy (Leucanthemum x superbum) is a perennial classic.

name: Shirley Poppy
detail: The Shirley poppy is the name of a group of annual ornamental varieties from the Papaver rhoeas (European wild poppy).

name: Shooting Star
detail: Dodecatheon media, a shooting star, is a very popular native North American wildflower, commonly found in open woods, prairies, meadows, rocky wooded slopes, and bluff ledges.

name: Silver Lace Vine
detail: Silver Lace Vine (Polygonum aubertii) is a popular but controversial climbing plant because of its vigorous growth habit.

name: Silverweed
detail: Potentilla anserine, also known as silverweed, goosegrass, or silverweed cinquefoil, is a prostrate perennial herb in the Rosaceae (rose) family.

name: Skunk Cabbage
detail: Skunk cabbage flower is not a real cabbage but rather belongs to a primarily tropical family of plants in the Araceae (Arum) family.

name: Snapdragon
detail: Snapdragons (Antirrhinum majus) are an annual classic cultivated for generations.

name: Snow in Summer
detail: Snow-in-summer (Cerastium tomentosum) offers a solid option for adding botanical beauty to retaining wall crevices and stones in a rock garden.

name: Snowberry
detail: Symphoricarpos, commonly called snowberry, ghost berry, or waxberry is a genus of around 15 species of deciduous shrubs in the Caprifoliaceae (honeysuckle) family.

name: Solanum
detail: Solanum is a diverse and large flowering plant genus that includes 3 food crops of great economic importance: eggplant, tomato, and potato.

name: Solidago
detail: Solidago, commonly known as goldenrod, is a genus of approximately 100 to 120 species of flowering plants in the Asteraceae family.

name: Solomon's Seal
detail: Polygonatum biflorum, commonly known as Solomon’s seal, is a classic garden shade plant that gives garden beds an architectural component thanks to its arched stems.

name: Southernwood
detail: Southernwood may seem like a minimal spread plant, but it has toured the world in the past few centuries.

name: Speedwell
detail: Veronica, also known as Speedwell, is an easy-to-grow, carefree perennial with long spikes of tiny white, pink, blue, or purple petals.

name: Spider Lily
detail: Hymenocallis littoralis or spider lily is a species of the Hymenocallis genus native to the temperate coastal areas of Latin America.

name: Spring Beauty
detail: Claytonia virginica is a perennial herb under the order Caryophyllales.

name: Squirrel Corn
detail: Dicentra canadensis is a perennial herb with blue-gray and fernlike foliage.

name: Star Magnolia
detail: Native to Japan, Star Magnolia is a small tree that can grow to 5 to 8 feet and spread 15 ft in maturity.

name: Starwort
detail: Stellaria longipes, a species of plant in the Caryophyllaceae family, are known by Goldie’s starwort and long stalk starwort.

name: Stephanotis
detail: Stephanotis is a genus of the Apocynaceae (dogbane milkweed) that contains around 15 species of climbing plants native to Madagascar and Southeast Asia.

name: Strawberry Banksia
detail: Banksia menziesii, also known as Strawberry Banksia or firewood Banksia, is a flowering plant of the genus Banksia.

name: Succory
detail: Common chicory (Cichorium intybus), known as radicchio or witloof, is a slightly woody perennial plant from the Asteraceae (daisy) family.

name: Sweet William
detail: Sweet William (Dianthus barbatus) is a species of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae native to parts of Asia and southern Europe.

name: Sweet Woodruff
detail: Sweet Woodruff (Galium odoratum) is a great statement plant in the shade garden.

name: Syringa
detail: Syringa is a genus of about 12 known species of woody flowering plants in the Oleaceae (olive) family native to forests and scrublands from eastern Asia to southeastern Europe.

name: Tamarix Shrubs
detail: Tamarix arceuthoides is a shrub or Tree belonging to the Tamaricaceae family.

name: Tansy
detail: The tansy (Tanacetum vulgare) is a perennial herbaceous plant of the Tanacetum genus in the Asteraceae family, native to temperate areas of Asia and Europe.

name: Tares
detail: Tares (Lolium temulentum), commonly known as Darnel, cockle, Darnel ryegrass, or Poison Darnel, is an annual flowering plant of the genus Lolium Poaceae family.

name: Tassel flower
detail: The Tassel flower is a small, intriguing plant on the front edge, producing tiny scarlet-orange pompoms that appear to float in mid-air when viewed from a distance.

name: Teasel
detail: Teasel (Dipsacus spp.) is a genus of plants from the Caprifoliaceae (honeysuckle) family.

name: Thornapple
detail: Datura stramonium, commonly known as thornapple, Jimson weed, devil’s trumpet, or devil’s snare, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Solanaceae (nightshade) family.

name: Throatwort
detail: Intricate and delicate, Throatwort (Trachelium caeruleum) dazzles with its thick cushions of blue-violet flowers and gives any garden or flower arrangement an elegant, lace-like charm.

name: Thunbergia
detail: Thunbergie has been called “the most gorgeous vine in the world” by some.

name: Tiger Lily
detail: Tiger Lily is a perennial Japanese bulb plant that can grow 60 cm to 150 cm.

name: Toad Lily
detail: Tricyrtis affinis is a perennial Japanese plant of the Liliaceae.

name: Trientalis
detail: Trientalis borealis is a star-shaped perennial wild-flowering plant native to the North American forests that bloom from May to June.

name: Turpentine Broom
detail: Turpentine Broom is a shrub of the family Rutaceae.

name: Vernonia
detail: The Vernonia genus includes 350 species of shrubs and forbs in the Asteraceae (sunflower) family.

name: Viburnum
detail: The Viburnum (aka snowball) is an old-fashioned shrub known for its many beautiful clusters of white snowball-shaped flowers.

name: Waling-Waling
detail: Vanda sanderiana is an endemic orchid growing wild only in the rainforests of the Philippines.

name: White Saxaul
detail: White Saxual is a tap-rooted shrub or small tree that belongs to the pigweed family.

name: White Trillium
detail: White Trillium is a perennial herb that belongs to the family Melanthiaceae.

name: White Wormwood
detail: White Wormwood is a perennial shrub of the order Asterales.

name: Wild Dagga
detail: Leonatis ocymifolia is a flowering shrub of the family Lamiaceae.

name: Wild Foxglove
detail: Ceratotheca triloba is an annual plant that belongs to the family Pedaliaceae.

name: Wild Narcissus
detail: Narcissus poeticus is a flowering plant of the order Asparagales.

name: Wisteria
detail: The Japanese Wisteria is a beautiful, deciduous climber with a height of 10 to 30 feet and a spread of 10-20 feet.

name: Wreath Lechenaultia
detail: Lechenaultia macrantha is a small herbaceous plant from the Goodeniaceae family.
